headline: Bank security guard killed in motorcycle crash on Hanif Flyover
summary: A 32-year-old man died after his bike hit a road divider in Jatrabari, Dhaka. Another man was injured in the accident.
details: A 32-year-old man was killed and another injured after their motorcycle hit a road divider on the Hanif Flyover in Dhaka's Jatrabari area.
The deceased has been identified as Chan Mia Kabir, a security guard at the Sonali Bank Motijheel branch.
The accident occurred around 12:30 am when the motorcycle lost control and crashed into the divider.
Passers-by rushed the two men to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH), where Kabir died around 8:30 am during treatment.
The injured man, 24-year-old Suman Mia, has been shifted to the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Prime Diagnostic Centre and Hospital.
Jatrabari police are currently investigating the incident.
caption:
A bank security guard has lost his life after a motorcycle crash on Dhaka's Hanif Flyover.

A 32-year-old man was killed and another injured after their motorcycle hit a road divider on the Hanif Flyover in Dhaka's Jatrabari area.

The deceased has been identified as Chan Mia Kabir, a security guard at the Sonali Bank Motijheel branch.

The accident occurred around 12:30 am when the motorcycle lost control and crashed into the divider.

Passers-by rushed the two men to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH), where Kabir died around 8:30 am during treatment.

The injured man, 24-year-old Suman Mia, has been shifted to the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Prime Diagnostic Centre and Hospital.

Jatrabari police are currently investigating the incident.

Source: Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline_marked: Tk 94L scam: [[2 arrested over Telegram job fraud]]
headline: Tk 94L scam: 2 arrested over Telegram job fraud
summary: CID police arrested two members of an online fraud ring for duping a man of over 94 lakh taka using a fake job offer on Telegram.
details: The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) of the police arrested two men for allegedly embezzling 94.19 lakh taka from a victim using a Telegram-based scam.
The suspects, identified as Md. Julhas Uddin (39) and Prahar (28), were arrested during an operation in the Kishoreganj Sadar police station area on Thursday night.
According to the CID, the fraud ring targeted a man named Mehedi Haq Neon in August last year by offering him a job through the Telegram app.
The victim was lured into a fake website where he was promised commissions for completing online orders and subsequently encouraged to invest larger sums for higher profits.
Mehedi filed a case with the Polton Police Station in Dhaka on January 3 after the scammers embezzled the money.
Following an investigation, the CID identified an organized gang and has arrested a total of 14 people so far, including the two most recent arrests.
caption:
A fake job offer on Telegram led to a loss of 94.19 lakh taka. Two more members of the fraud ring have now been arrested.

The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) of the police arrested two men for allegedly embezzling 94.19 lakh taka from a victim using a Telegram-based scam.

The suspects, identified as Md. Julhas Uddin (39) and Prahar (28), were arrested during an operation in the Kishoreganj Sadar police station area on Thursday night.

According to the CID, the fraud ring targeted a man named Mehedi Haq Neon in August last year by offering him a job through the Telegram app.

The victim was lured into a fake website where he was promised commissions for completing online orders and subsequently encouraged to invest larger sums for higher profits.

Mehedi filed a case with the Polton Police Station in Dhaka on January 3 after the scammers embezzled the money.

Following an investigation, the CID identified an organized gang and has arrested a total of 14 people so far, including the two most recent arrests.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo
